what_is.title: What is perform?
what_is.description: An exclusive technical management platform based on the CIEP system. It's not a course; it's a comprehensive tracking program to transform your performance.

how_works.title: How it works
how_works.step1_desc: Submit your request detailing your sports profile and goals.
how_works.step2_desc: Personalized assessment to validate compatibility with the program.
how_works.step3_desc: In-depth analysis of your technical and cognitive capabilities.
how_works.step4_desc: Access to the intensive training plan and data tracking.
